svg.text: OIDC federation — AWS credentials with no stored keys
THE WAY MOST TEAMS DO IT
never expires . works from anywhere in the world
nobody knows if it leaked . rotation is a manual chore
one leaked log line and it is game over
OIDC FEDERATION — what you build in this module
THE TRUST POLICY IS THE CONTROL
Only while a workflow is running.
A fork or a feature branch cannot assume it.
WHAT YOU NEVER HAVE TO DO AGAIN
no key to leak in a log
You have seen this pattern before today
Module 12: the AWS Load Balancer Controller pod assumed an IAM role through IRSA, using the cluster
OIDC provider. No key was stored in the pod.
Module 14: a GitHub Actions job assumes an IAM role through OIDC, using GitHub as the provider.
Same mechanism, different identity source. Learn it once, use it everywhere.
